name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: Detailed snow forecast to +144 h with wet-bulb-zero snowline contours, terrain comparison, precipitation and modelled snow depth. Version 4.0.3 polishes graph metadata and consistently labels modelled snow depth across the graph and PNG export.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
